notifications.cycle.fertileWindow.body: Ngokwemininingwane yomjikelezo wakho, isikhathi sakho sokuzala esilinganiselwayo siqala maduze.

notifications.cycle.ovulation.body: Ngokwendlela ozilandelela ngayo, i-ovulation yakho ilinganiselwa maduze.

notifications.conception.lhTest.title: Isikhathi sokuhlolwa kwakho kwe-ovulation (LH)
notifications.conception.lhTest.body: Lesi yisikhathi esihle sokwenza ukuhlolwa kwakho kwe-LH.
notifications.conception.temperature.bod: Ungakhohlwa ukukala izinga lakho lokushisa ngaphambi kokuvuka embhedeni.

help.faq.cycle-record-period.question: Ngiqopha kanjani isikhathi sami?
help.faq.cycle-record-period.subtitle: Engeza izinsuku nobude besikhathi sakho.
help.faq.cycle-record-period.answer: Ekhalendeni noma kuJenali yansuku zonke, qopha ukuthi isikhathi sakho siqala nini, sithatha isikhathi esingakanani, nokuthi ukugeleza kuhlangene kangakanani. Lolu lwazi lakha umlando wakho siqu futhi luphakela ukulinganisa okuboniswa ku-AWA.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.question: Ngingayihlela yini usuku lwesikhathi?
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.subtitle: Lungisa usuku uma ukulandelela kwakho kushintshile.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.answer: Yebo. Hlela usuku olufanele ekulandelelweni kwakho ukuze umlando wakho uhambisane nomjikelezo wakho wangempela. Ukulinganisa kungase kushintshe ngokwemininingwane esanda kulondolozwa.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.question: Isikhathi sami esilandelayo sibalwa kanjani?
help.faq.cycle-predictions.subtitle: Ukulinganisa okusekelwe emlandweni wakho siqu.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.answer: I-AWA ilinganisa isikhathi sakho esilandelayo, iwindi lokuzala ne-ovulation ngokomlando wakho siqu, ubude bomjikelezo wakho, nolwazi oluqophayo. Ukulinganisa akusoze kwasekelwa kumjikelezo ojwayelekile wezinsuku ezingu-28 kuphela.
help.faq.cycle-flow.question: Ngilandelela kanjani ukugeleza kwesikhathi sami?
help.faq.cycle-flow.subtitle: Qopha ukuthi ukopha kwakho kushintsha kanjani.
help.faq.cycle-flow.answer: Sebenzisa iJenali yansuku zonke ukuze uphawule ukuthi ukugeleza kwesikhathi sakho kuhlangene kangakanani. Lokhu kugcina umlando wokuthi kushintsha kanjani kuyo yonke imijikelezo yakho.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.question: Zisho ukuthini izimpawu zekhalenda?
help.faq.cycle-calendar.subtitle: Isikhathi, ukuzala, i-ovulation nekhalenda likaHijri.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.answer: Ikhalenda libonisa izinsuku zesikhathi sakho oziqophile kanye neziwindi zakho zokuzala ne-ovulation ezilinganiselwayo. Uma izimpawu zokholo zivuliwe, usuku lukaHijri nalo lungabonakala eduze kosuku lwekhalenda lakwamanye amazwe.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.subtitl: Bona izinsuku ezilinganiselwa ukuthi zinokuzala okukhulu.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.answer: Endleleni Yokuzama Ukukhulelwa, i-AWA ibonisa iwindi lokuzala elilinganiselwayo elisekelwe olwazini lomjikelezo wakho nomlando wakho siqu.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.question: I-ovulation yami ilinganiselwa kanjani?
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.subtitle: Ukulinganisa okuvuselelwa njengoba ulandelela.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.answer: I-ovulation ilinganiselwa ngolwazi olutholakala emlandweni womjikelezo wakho. Lokhu kulinganisa kungashintsha uma wengeza idatha entsha.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.question: Ngingalandelela yini izinga lokushisa lomzimba wami?
help.faq.conceive-temperature.subtitle: Engeza izinga lakho lokushisa ekulandeleleni kokuzala.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.answer: Yebo. Ukulandelela izinga lokushisa lomzimba kuyingxenye yendlela ekhethekile yokukhulelwa.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.answer: Yebo. Ukulandelela ubuthi bomlomo wesibeletho kungolunye lolwazi olutholakala Endleleni Yokuzama Ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.question: Ngingaqopha yini ukuhlolwa kwe-ovulation kwe-LH?
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.subtitle: Gcina imiphumela yakho ekulandelelweni kwakho.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.answer: Yebo. Ukuqopha ukuhlolwa kwe-ovulation kwe-LH kuyingxenye yohambo lokukhulelwa.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.question: Ngiqopha kanjani ukwenza ucansi?
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.subtitle: Imininingwane eyimfihlo ejenalini yakho.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.answer: Ingxenye Yobunye ikuvumela ukuthi uqophe ukwenza ucansi nolunye ulwazi oluhlobene. Le ngxenye iyimfihlo futhi ingavikelwa ngokwehlukile.
help.faq.contraception-method.question: Yiziphi izindlela zokuvikela ukukhulelwa engingazilandelela?
help.faq.contraception-method.subtitle: Ipilisi, indandatho, i-patch nokwelashwa nge-hormone.
help.faq.contraception-method.answer: I-AWA isekela ukulandelela ipilisi lokuvikela ukukhulelwa, indandatho yangaphakathi emaleni, i-patch yokuvikela ukukhulelwa, nezinye izindlela zokwelashwa nge-hormone.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.ans: Yebo. I-AWA inikeza izikhumbuzo ongazishintsha zokuphuza ipilisi lakho, kanye nezaziso zansuku zonke.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.an: Yebo. Ukulandelela amadosi akhohliwe kuyingxenye yohambo lokuvikela ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.contraception-history.question: Ngingawutholaphi umlando wokuphuza kwami?
help.faq.contraception-history.subtitle: Buyekeza amadosi aqoshiwe namapilisi akhohliwe.
help.faq.contraception-history.answer: Kukhona umlando wokuphuza ukuze ugcine irekhodi lokulandelela kwakho indlela yokuvikela ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.quest: Ingabe ukulinganisa kusalusizo ngenkathi ngivikela ukukhulelwa?
help.faq.contraception-predictions.subti: Ezinye izindlela zingashintsha umjikelezo wakho wemvelo.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.answe: I-AWA ingaqhubeka ibonisa ulwazi lokulandelela olutholakalayo, kodwa indlela ozihumusha ngayo izilinganiso incike esimweni sakho nasendleleni oyisebenzisayo. Uhlelo alusoze lwangena esikhundleni seseluleko sezokwelashwa.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.question: Ingabe umjikelezo omude uthathwa njengo"sibambezelekile"?
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.subtitle: I-AWA icabangela imijikelezo engahleliwe.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.answer: Cha. Endleleni ye-PCOS/Imijikelezo engahleliwe, i-AWA ayisoze yathatha ngokuzenzakalelayo umjikelezo omude njengo"sibambezelekile."
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.question: Yiziphi izimpawu engingazilandelela nge-PCOS?
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.subtitle: Phawula izimpawu ezishintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.answer: Ukulandelela kuhlanganisa imijikelezo engahleliwe, ubuhlungu bebuso, ukukhula kwezinviyo, ushintsho lwesisindo nezimpawu ezihlobene.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.question: Ngingalandelela yini ubuhlungu bebuso nokukhula kwezinviyo?
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.subtitle: Engeza lokho okubonile ekulandeleleni kwakho kwe-PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.answer: Yebo. Ubuhlungu bebuso nokukhula kwezinviyo kuyingxenye ecacile yokulandelela okulungiselelwe i-PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-weight.question: Ngingalandelela yini ushintsho lwesisindo sami?
help.faq.irregular-weight.subtitle: Phawula ukuthi isisindo sakho sishintsha kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
help.faq.irregular-weight.answer: Yebo. Ukulandelela isisindo kutholakala Endleleni ye-PCOS/Imijikelezo engahleliwe.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.question: Kungani ukulinganisa kwami kushintsha kakhulu?
help.faq.irregular-predictions.subtitle: Imijikelezo engahleliwe yenza ukulinganisa kungazinzi.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.answer: Uma imijikelezo ingahleliwe, ukulinganisa kungashintsha kakhulu ngokwemvelo. I-AWA isebenzisa umlando wakho siqu ngaphandle kokuthatha ngokuzenzakalelayo umjikelezo omude njengosibambezelekile.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.question: Yiziphi izimpawu engingazilandelela?
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.subtitle: Ukulandelela okulungele ushintsho lwalesi sigaba sempilo.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.answer: Ukulandelela kuhlanganisa ukushisa kwesikhashana komzimba, ukujuluka ebusuku, izinkinga zokulala, ukukhathala, ushintsho lwemizwa nenkungu yengqondo, nokunye.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.question: Ngingaqopha yini ukushisa kwami kwesikhashana komzimba?
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.subtitle: Phawula ukuthi kuvama kangakanani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.answer: Yebo. Ukushisa kwesikhashana komzimba kungomunye wezimpawu ezitholakala Endleleni ye-Perimenopause/Menopause.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.question: Ngingalandelela yini ukulala nokukhathala kwami?
help.faq.menopause-sleep.subtitle: Phawula izinkinga zokulala nokukhathala.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.answer: Yebo. Izinkinga zokulala, ukujuluka ebusuku nokukhathala konke kutholakala kulolu hambo.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.an: Yebo. Ungalandelela ukwelashwa nge-hormone njengengxenye yale ndlela.
help.faq.menopause-labs.question: Ngingaqopha yini imiphumela yami ye-FSH ne-estradiol?
help.faq.menopause-labs.subtitle: Engeza eminye imiphumela yocwaningo lwegazi ekulandeleleni kwakho.
help.faq.menopause-labs.answer: Yebo. Imiphumela yocwaningo efana ne-FSH ne-estradiol ingaqoshwa kule ndlela.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.question: Usuku lwami lokubeletha lubalwa kanjani?
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.subtitle: Ukulinganisa okuboniswa ekulandeleleni kwakho ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.answer: Ukulandelela ukukhulelwa kubala usuku lwakho lokubeletha olulinganiselwayo ngolwazi olutholakala ekulandeleleni kwakho.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.question: Ngingalandelela yini ukukhulelwa kwami iviki ngeviki?
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.subtitle: Bheka ukuthi ukukhulelwa kwakho kuqhubeka kanjani iviki ngeviki.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.answer: Yebo. I-AWA inikeza ukulandelela iviki ngeviki futhi ibonisa ukuthi ukukhulelwa kwakho kuqhubeka kanjani.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.question: Ngingaqopha yini izikhathi zami zokubona udokotela?
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.subtitle: Gcina izikhathi zakho ezibalulekile endaweni eyodwa.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.answer: Yebo. Izikhathi zokubona udokotela nokuhlolwa okubalulekile kuyingxenye yokulandelela ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.question: Ngingathola yini izikhumbuzo zokuhlolwa kwami?
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.subtitle: Setha izikhumbuzo ozikhethele zona.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.answer: Yebo. Izikhumbuzo ozikhethele zona zezikhathi zokubona udokotela nokuhlolwa okubalulekile ziyatholakala.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.question: Ngingalandelela ini ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa?
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.subtitle: Izimpawu, isisindo, isimo sengqondo, ukulala nolwazi lwakho siqu.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.answer: Ukulandelela ukukhulelwa kungahlanganisa izimpawu ozizwayo, isisindo, isimo sengqondo, ukulala nolwazi lwakho siqu lwezokwelashwa.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.question: Ngilandelela kanjani i-lochia?
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.subtitle: Phawula ubude nokuthi ukuphuma kushintsha kanjani.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.answer: Ukulandelela ngemuva kokubeletha kuhlanganisa ubude be-lochia, ukuthi ukugeleza kushintsha kanjani, nezimpawu ezihlobene.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.subtitl: Bheka umjikelezo wakho ubuya kancane kancane.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.answer: I-AWA ilandelela ukubuya komjikelezo wakho, ukubuya kwesikhathi sakho, noshintsho lwakho lwe-hormone ngemuva kokubeletha.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.questi: Ngingalandelela yini ukuncelisa nokungabi nasikhathi ngenxa yokuncelisa?
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.subtit: Gcina lolu lwazi ohambweni lwakho lwangemuva kokubeletha.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.answer: Yebo. Ukuncelisa nokungabi nasikhathi ngemuva kokubeletha kuyingxenye yokulandelela okutholakalayo.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.question: Ngingalandelela ini ngesikhathi sokululama?
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.subtitle: Ukukhathala, ukulala, isimo sengqondo, ubuhlungu nokululama komzimba.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.answer: Ukulandelela kwansuku zonke ngemuva kokubeletha kuhlanganisa ukukhathala, ukulala, isimo sengqondo, ubuhlungu nokululama komzimba, nokunye.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.question: I-AWA iyiphatha kanjani i-nifas?
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.subtitle: Uphawu lokholo, olwehlukile ekulandeleleni kwezokwelashwa.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.answer: Uma izimpawu zokholo zivuliwe, i-AWA ingalandelela ubude bokopha ngemuva kokubeletha futhi ibonise isikhathi sesikhombi se-nifas ngokwesikhombi sokholo esikhethiwe. Isikhathi esiphezulu singahluka phakathi kwezikole zokucabanga futhi asisoze sethulwa njengeqiniso elilodwa lonke lapho imibono ihluka.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.question: Ngilandelela kanjani ukopha kwami?
help.faq.loss-bleeding.subtitle: Bheka ukuthi kushintsha kanjani, ngaphandle kokuphuthuma ukubuyela ekulandeleleni okujwayelekile.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.answer: Uhambo Lwangemuva Kokuphunyelwa Yisisu lulandelela ukopha nokuthi kushintsha kanjani, endaweni elungele lesi sikhathi.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.question: Ngilandelela kanjani ukubuya komjikelezo wami?
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.subtitle: Qalisa kabusha ukulandelela ngesivinini sakho.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.answer: I-AWA ilandelela ukubuya komjikelezo wakho ngemuva kokuphunyelwa yisisu, ikuvumela ukuthi ubuyisele umlando wakho kancane kancane ngaphandle kokuphoqa ukulandelela isikhathi okujwayelekile ngokushesha.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.question: Yiziphi izimpawu engingazaqopha?
help.faq.loss-symptoms.subtitle: Landelela izimpawu zomzimba ofuna ukuziphawula.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.answer: Ukulandelela izimpawu zomzimba kuyatholakala kulolu hambo.
help.faq.loss-notes.question: Ngingagcina yini amanothi ami siqu?
help.faq.loss-notes.subtitle: Indawo yakho siqu ejenalini.
help.faq.loss-notes.answer: Yebo. Amanothi akho siqu ayatholakala ukuze akuphelezele kulesi sikhathi.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.question: Ngingabuyela yini ekuzameni ukukhulelwa ngemuva kwalokho?
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.subtitle: Shintsha inhloso yakho noma nini uma ufuna ukuzama futhi.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.answer: Ukusekelwa kokuqala kabusha ukuzama ukukhulelwa kufakiwe. Ukushintsha inhloso yakho kuqhubeka kancane kancane futhi kuhlala kuyisinqumo sakho.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.question: Ikhalenda likaHijri lisebenza kanjani?
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.subtitle: Libonisa usuku lukaHijri eduze kosuku lwekhalenda lakwamanye amazwe.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.answer: Uma izimpawu zokholo zivuliwe, i-AWA ingabonisa usuku lukaHijri eduze kosuku lwekhalenda lakwamanye amazwe futhi iphawule izinyanga ezibalulekile njengeRamadan noma iDhul Hijjah.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.question: Isho ukuthini isimo sokuhlanzeka?
help.faq.spiritual-purity.subtitle: Uphawu oluyimfihlo oluhlobene nokuqala kabusha ukukhulekela.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.answer: I-AWA ingabonisa isikhombi esiyimfihlo esihlukanisa isikhathi sakho nesikhathi sakho sokuhlanzeka uma izimpawu zokholo zivuliwe.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.questio: I-AWA ibonisa kanjani ukuthi ukukhuleka kuqala kabusha nini?
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.answer: Uma ukuhlanzeka kubuya ngaphambi kokuba kuphele isikhathi salesi salat, uhlelo lungaphawula ukuthi lesi salat siyabuya sibe sesifanele. Ama-salat aphuthelwe ngesikhathi sakho awasoze abalwa njengama-salat okufanele abuyiselwe.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.question: Ukulandelela ukuzila okufanele kubuyiselwe kusebenza kanjani?
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.subtitle: Kubala izinsuku eziphuthelwe ngenxa yesikhathi sakho.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.answer: I-AWA ingahlinzeka ngekhawunta yezinsuku zokuzila eziphuthelwe ngenxa yesikhathi sakho, ikakhulukazi ngeRamadan, kanye nesikhumbuzo esithambile emva kwenyanga sokuhlela ukuzibuyisela.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.question: I-nifas iboniswa kanjani?
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.subtitle: Uphawu olungahluka phakathi kwezikole zokucabanga.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.answer: I-AWA ingabonisa isikhombi sokholo esikhethiwe sesikhathi esiphezulu se-nifas, iphawule ukwehluka phakathi kwezikole lapho okuqukethwe okuqinisekisiwe kukuhlanganisa. Uhlelo alusoze lwethula inombolo eyodwa njengeqiniso eliphelele.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.question: Ingabe i-AWA inikeza iseluleko ngeistihada?
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.subtitle: Okuqukethwe kokufundisa, hhayi i-fatwa eyakhelwe wena.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.answer: I-AWA ingahlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okuvamile kokufundisa mayelana ne-istihada nokuthi isho ukuthini ekukhulekeni. Uhlelo aluyikhiphi i-fatwa eyakhelwe umuntu, futhi okuqukethwe kwezenkolo kuhloselwe ukuqinisekiswa yisigungu esaziwayo.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.question: Ngingaqopha ini ejenalini yami?
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Izimpawu, isimo sengqondo, ubunye, ukulala nokuzivocavoca.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answer: IJenali yansuku zonke ihlanganisa izimpawu zomzimba, isimo semizwa, ubunye, ukulala, ukuzivocavoca nezinothi zakho siqu.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Izimpawu, isimo sengqondo, ukulala, ukuzivocavoca, ukuphuza amanzi, ukugeleza kwesikhathi namanothi.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answerDa: IJenali yansuku zonke ikuvumela ukuthi ulandelele izimpawu zomzimba, isimo sengqondo, ukulala, ukuzivocavoca, ukuphuza amanzi, ukugeleza kwesikhathi namanothi akho siqu.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.question: Ingabe Ingxenye Yobunye yami ingavikelwa?
help.faq.journal-intimacy.subtitle: Ingxenye eyimfihlo, ehlukile.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.answer: Yebo. Ingxenye Yobunye ingafihlwa futhi ivikelwe nge-PIN noma i-Face ID yayo ehlukile.
